key_features: Ergonomic Design: Designed for extended gaming sessions, offering optimal comfort and support.
Adjustable Tilt Mechanism: Supports tilt customization for a relaxed or upright seating position.
High Load Capacity: Sturdy construction supports users up to 120 kg (264.5 lb).
Durable Build: Crafted with quality materials for long-lasting durability.
Sleek Gaming Aesthetics: Stylish orange accents enhance the look of any gaming setup.
Comfortable Padding: Thick seat and backrest cushions provide plush support during long use.
Lightweight Construction: Weighs only 15.2 kg (33.5 lb), making it easy to move and adjust.
No Warranty: Ideal for users looking for a budget-friendly, entry-level gaming chair.
